title: BREAKING: Haley Stevens Endorses Republican in Final Attempt to Tank Abdul El-Sayed
author: Prem Thakker

After failing to force Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed to
bow to her position on Israel, Democrat Haley Stevens endorsed El-Sayed's
Republican opponent on Sunday, two days before the election.

Over the past week, Stevens and her pro-Israel fiance made various, escalating
attempts to blow up the race. Stevens repeatedly demanded that El-Sayed
condemn a random super PAC's anti-Israel ad and take down his own campaign ad,
which includes a clip of former Fox host Tucker Carlson slamming Republican
nominee Mike Rogers.

Stevens then [announced](https://x.com/HaleyforMI/status/2116161977256980989)
Friday she would appear at a party unity event at a Detroit church Sunday with
El-Sayed and Democratic Rep. James Clyburn, while again trying to force El-
Sayed to commit to her views on Israel. El-Sayed released his own statement
criticizing Stevens for "relitigating a primary that ended three months ago."
[Reports](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/30/el-sayed-stevens-senate-
race-fight-01144423) soon trickled out that El-Sayed's campaign would not have
Stevens at any of his campaign events, and the candidate confirmed as much. "I
don't want any distractions," El-Sayed
[said](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/31/us/elections/el-sayed-haley-stevens-
democrats-tension.html) Saturday.

"As you may have seen, our Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, Abdul, said
that I was no longer welcome in his campaign and that I should stay away,"
Stevens said in a Twitter video Sunday. "And he's right, and that's why I am
endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today. I don't belong in
Abdul's campaign."

She suggested El-Sayed has been spreading "hate," even though Rogers and
Republicans - including President Donald Trump - have led [an openly
Islamophobic smear campaign](https://zeteo.com/p/why-i-am-thanking-bill-and-
hillary) against El-Sayed, who would be America's first Muslim senator.

The move generated immediate backlash, including mass
[resignations](https://x.com/nannburke/status/2116942694287385060?a=1Jrobw1ADeSbrMom1-4&s=46)
from her official staff.

Michigan Democratic Party Chair Curtis Hertel
[said](https://x.com/polltracker2024/status/2116949969206714521?a=qo_7kyDKWsqKec9x1rc&s=46)
that Stevens's decision "shows that she has abandoned everything she claims to
care about," and that the party "will not allow these eleventh-hour
distractions deter us."

DNC Black Caucus chair Virgie Rollins
[said](https://x.com/MacFarlaneNews/status/2116953599536443732) Stevens "has
revealed herself to be a sellout who used Black Michiganders for a political
stunt." Center for American Progress president Neera Tanden called the move a
"betrayal" of Stevens's supporters.

Stevens was the Democratic Party establishment's pick in the Michigan Senate
race, and had the [public
support](https://punchbowl.news/article/campaigns/schumer-stevens/) of Senate
Minority Leader Chuck Schumer. She narrowly lost to El-Sayed in the primary,
despite having [$30 million](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/fact-
checking-abdul-el-sayed-and-haley-stevens-claims-ahead-of-the-michigan-
democratic-senate-primary) spent on her behalf by the pro-Israel lobby AIPAC.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-haley-stevens-endorses-
republican?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Since the primary, Stevens had not made appearances alongside the Democratic
nominee. Whenever she was asked about El-Sayed, she'd deflect, and eventually,
begrudgingly, say she was supporting the ticket.

That changed this week. Alongside Stevens throughout all this has been her new
fiance, Jason Turkish, an attorney who has donated thousands to her, as well
as a slate of other pro-Israel politicians
[including](https://www.fec.gov/data/receipts/?data_type=processed&contributor_name=jason+turkish&two_year_transaction_period=2026&min_date=01%2F01%2F2025&max_date=12%2F31%2F2026)
Democrat John Fetterman and GOP Senator Susan Collins.

Turkish
[announced](https://www.google.com/search?q=jason+turkish+announces+he+will+vote+for+mike+rogers+october&oq=jason+turkish+announces+he+will+vote+for+mike+rogers+october&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyCQgAEEUYORigATIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigATIHCAQQIRigAdIBCDUyODNqMGo3qAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&source=chrome.ob&ie=UTF-8)
Wednesday he would be voting for Rogers, and proceeded to be featured on
several news outlets - including Fox, Tucker Carlson's former employer - to
attack El-Sayed and promote Rogers. He even
[appeared](https://forward.com/fast-forward/859079/mike-rogers-campaign-event-
for-jews-brings-out-haley-stevens-fiancee/) alongside Rogers and Texas senator
Ted Cruz at a campaign event. All the while, as the unity event was breaking
down, Turkish was said to have been involved in
[negotiating](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/30/politics/live-news/midterm-
election-congress?post-id=cmvv3r7sl000o3b6urr2nowpz) terms to ensure his
fiancee's participation - even though he was actively supporting El-Sayed's
opponent.

In conversations with the _New York Times_ on Friday, Stevens [told the
paper](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/31/us/haley-stevens-abdul-el-
sayed.html) she was still supporting El-Sayed. She suggested that, in early
2025, she and El-Sayed had both committed to supporting each other's campaign
if the other won.

Turkish, for his part, [told](https://www.tmz.com/2026/10/30/haley-stevens-
fiance-abdul-el-sayed-support-warning/) TMZ, "I don't think she's going to be
supporting Abdul El-Sayed very much longer."

Minutes before Stevens endorsed Rogers, the _Detroit News_
[reported](https://x.com/nannburke/status/2116942694287385060) that Haley
Stevens's "official staff including her longtime chief are resigning from her
office this morning."

In August, Stevens
[tweeted](https://x.com/haleyformi/status/2083541895905530201?a=wJzcOfApz7KhGU-
vgcc&s=46) that "Mike Rogers will be another rubber stamp for Donald Trump's
dangerous agenda. We can't afford to give MAGA another Senate seat in
November."

Apparently, ensuring Congress remains as pro-Israel as Haley Stevens is more
important.
